content.short: Mantle is an Ethereum Layer 2 network built for lower fees, faster finality, and EVM compatible application deployment.
content.description: Mantle is an Ethereum Layer 2 network designed around a modular architecture. Its official materials describe a rollup that works with a decentralized data availability layer so builders can deploy EVM applications with lower fees and faster finality while staying connected to Ethereum. Mantle is aimed at teams building DeFi, gaming, and broader consumer or institutional products that want familiar tooling without giving up throughput or execution efficiency across a more scalable network environment.
content.meta: Mantle provides Ethereum Layer 2 infrastructure with lower fees and EVM compatibility. Discover Mantle on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
